variants.name: 10-cauda-aerea
variants.prompt: Create ONE square raster app-icon concept for Skadi, a marine terminal. Bold readable design with few shapes, restrained detail. Palette exclusively dark navy #061B35, aquamarine #48DCCB, turquoise #26BFCB and clean WHITE; no cream/yellow/beige. No text, letters, mockups, bevels or glossy effects. Generous margins. Humpback anatomy recognizable: broad flukes with center notch, very long pectoral fins where shown, substantial curved body. View from directly overhead: a wide humpback tail seen just beneath clear dark water, flukes nearly horizontal, a narrow tail stock entering from TOP edge of composition. Strong aquamarine caustic stripes across the two broad navy flukes and a few irregular white identifying patches. One broken turquoise ripple circle surrounds it. Highly simplified Japanese stencil print, only about 6 broad shapes, NOT a tail rising vertically. No scenery.
